evidence.detail: Model.a(byte[], int, boolean) reads the model payload trailer through Stream, creates one rs/v entry for the model id, stores the original byte array, and writes the three leading decoded counts plus a sequence of computed section offsets into the object.

Model construction copies rs/v.b, rs/v.c and rs/v.d directly into its core vertex-count, face-count and textured-triangle-count state before allocating/obtaining the corresponding vertex, face and texture arrays.

The remaining rs/v integer fields are treated as optional or mandatory byte offsets into the same model payload; Model creates several Stream views, positions them at those offsets and decodes the individual model sections.

candidates.note: ModelHeader describes the per-model byte-array metadata record containing decode counts and section offsets; it is a semantic recovery name rather than a claim about the original developer identifier.
